name: Stacking Cards
description: Layered 3D sticky stack cards with progressive scroll depth scale decay and reverse scaling exit mechanics.

props.name: topStart
props.label: Top Start (px)
props.description: Offset in pixels from top of viewport for the first sticky card.

props.name: topIncrement
props.label: Top Increment (px)
props.description: Vertical stacking offset in pixels for each subsequent card.

props.name: scaleThreshold
props.label: Scale Threshold (px)
props.description: Scroll distance threshold over which progressive scaling activates.

props.name: minScale
props.label: Minimum Scale
props.description: Minimum scale applied to the base card in the stack.

vue.description: Vue 3 Stacking Cards outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { StackingCards as StackingCardsPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <StackingCardsPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="cn('relative flex flex-col gap-8 w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </StackingCardsPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Stacking Cards adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { StackingCards as StackingCardsPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<StackingCardsPrimitive
  class={cn('relative flex flex-col gap-8 w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</StackingCardsPrimitive>
